summary: Apple's TabularData is a typed data-frame library for preparing machine-learning training tables (DataFrame, typed columns, statistical summaries, CSV/JSON import and export). BifrOSt has no data-frame or typed-column type and no statistics layer; the only table-like pieces are the UI table's sort model, a JSON Codable layer and an ad hoc CSV parser inside the weather widget. Overall status n/a because the framework serves ML training pipelines that the desktop does not provide and no app needs.

features.note: no row-and-column container type in the SDK or ui crates; ML training tables are not a desktop feature

features.apple: Column, ColumnSlice, FilledColumn, DiscontiguousColumnSlice, ColumnProtocol, OptionalColumnProtocol
features.note: table.rs Column is a UI view column (id, title, width), not a typed data column; no element typing or missing-value handling
depends on typed columns, which BifrOSt does not have
